views.name: enerji_tesis
views.statement:
SELECT t.yil, t.ay,
       t.uretim_kg, t.sevkiyat_kg,
       t.sebeke_kwh, t.ges_kwh, t.toplam_elektrik_kwh, t.fatura_tl,
       t.kuyu_su_m3, t.atiksu_m3,
       p.toplam_tep, p.elektrik_tep, p.dogalgaz_tep, p.kati_yakit_tep,
       y.kati_yakit_kg, y.buhar_ton, y.kazan_dogalgaz_sm3,
       u.tep_proses,
       make_date(t.yil, t.ay, 1) AS donem_tarih
FROM tesis_enerji_aylik t
LEFT JOIN tep_ozet p ON p.yil = t.yil AND p.ay = t.ay
LEFT JOIN uretim_aylik_ozet u ON u.yil = t.yil AND u.ay = t.ay
LEFT JOIN yakit_karmasi y ON y.yil = t.yil AND y.ay = t.ay
